John initially has 13 lego sets. He sells some of them at $15 each to raise money. He buys 8 video games at $20 each, spending \(8 \times 20 = \$160\), and has \$5 left. So the total amount he received from selling lego sets is \(160 + 5 = \$165\). The number of lego sets he sold is \(165 \div 15 = 11\). Since he started with 13 sets, he still has \(13 - 11 = 2\) lego sets.

Answer: 2
